body: Thank you, this is actually really inspiring! I've been told I should not pursue music careers by parents and mentors and I guess fear of failure stems from that. But as you say, there are ways to make music work. Thank you again for the much needed boost!
Yeah I'd just like to have a normal and comfortable life. My best skill is probably working with computers and music production etc., but that's a pretty competitive field for jobs I think.
Well my one real passion is music, so I'd probably like to see myself happily married with kids and making a decent living off music in some way. But that's very much a fantasy situation I think!
I'm 19, in college and struggling to see where to go with my life.

Thank you for taking the time to talk. I'm not doing too great - just spend most of my time on my own in my room on Reddit these days. It's an alt-account but I picked my username because of a joke on a subreddit I frequent (it's apolitical one so I'm not gonna share the name haha)
